name: xiaofa-litigation-assistant
description: Legal assistant toolkit for self-represented litigants. 11 common case types with calculator, complaint templates, evidence organizer, procedure guides, timeline, enforcement, element-style complaint conversion, and DOCX output. Powered by 7 legal skills.

displayDescription.en: Litigation assistant: complaint drafting, element-style conversion, evidence organizer, procedure guides, enforcement, interest calculator. Outputs DOCX files. 7 legal skills, all-in-one self-service.
displayDescription.zh: 诉讼助手：起草起诉状、要素式转换、证据整理、流程指引、强制执行、利息计算。输出 DOCX 格式，Word/WPS 直接编辑。7大法律技能，一站式自助办案。
